1.name: Beats of Battle
1.description: Immerse your group in an ominous beat, increasing their Strength, Agility, and Dexterity by 2 (L1) to 4 (L16) for 18 seconds.

1.name: Hymn of the Dead
1.description: Immerse your target in a solemn hymn, revealing the direction of their corpse in the current zone.

1.name: Throw
1.description: Throw a throwing weapon at your target. Requires throwing weapon.

1.name: Whistling Slash
1.description: Whistle an invigorating tune as you slash at your target, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing your Strength by 5 for 30 seconds. This ability requires a one-handed weapon.

2.name: Screaming Vocalization
2.description: Release a guttural shout at your target, dealing 2 (L1) to 5 (L4) Magic Damage, with 150% (L1) to 350% (L60) damage variance. Shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

3.name: Somniferous Serenade
3.description: Enthrall your target with a somniferous serenade, incapacitating them for 18 seconds. This ability is removed by damage.

4.name: Healing Hymn
4.description: Immerse your group in a soothing hymn, increasing their Health Regeneration by 2 (L1) to 12 (L60) for 18 seconds.

4.name: Siren's Call
4.description: Enthrall your target with an alluring call, forcing them to fight for you for up to 18 seconds. This ability has a slight chance to end early.

5.name: Traveler's March
5.description: Inspire your group with a rousing march, increasing their Movement Speed by 20% (L5) to 65% (L60) for 18 seconds. Can only be used outdoors.

6.name: Chant of Purity
6.description: Immerse your gorup in a rhythmic chant, increasing their Poison and Disease Resistance by 5 (L6) to 10 (L26) for 18 seconds.
6.valuesSummary: +5–10 Poison and Disease Resistance (L6–L26) · +5–10 Disease Resistance (L6–L26)

7.name: Repel
7.description: Shriek at your target and those around it, decreasing your Threat against them by 75 (L1) to 750 (L60). Costs Mana and Shares a cooldown with other shouts.

8.name: Lento's Aria of Stillness
8.description: Oppress nearby targets with an echoing aria, decreasing their Movement Speed by 20% and Attack Speed by 10% for 18 seconds. This ability is considered a Secondary Slow.

8.name: Vellicosa's Fanfare
8.description: Blast your target with an ominous fanfare, dealing 8 (L8) to 100 (L60) Magic Damage every 6 seconds for 18 seconds.

9.name: Languid Lullaby
9.description: Soothe your target with a languid lullaby, reducing their Aggro Radius for 18 seconds. Has a very slight chance to end early and has additional effects in PvP.

10.name: Dissonant Vocalization
10.description: Release a dissonant shout at your target, dealing 15 Magic Damage plus 150% (L1) to 350% (L60) damage variance. Costs Mana. Shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

11.name: Unifying Anthem
11.description: Captivate your target with a unifying anthem, increasing your faction standing with them by 10000 (L1) to 20000 (L60) for 18 seconds. This ability is currently disabled (as of 3/11/2026).

12.name: Faedawyn's Arcane Alacrity
12.description: Inspire your group with an energetic allegro, increasing their Casting Speed by 10% for 18 seconds.

12.name: Overture of Speed
12.description: Inspire your group with an energetic allegro, increasing their Attack Speed by 10% for 18 seconds. This ability is considered a Secondary Haste.

12.name: Chords of Quickness
12.description: Inspire your group with an energetic allegro, increasing their Attack Speed by 10% (L12) to 15% (L16) for 18 seconds.

12.name: Siren's Allure
12.description: Charm your target with an alluring melody, forcing them to fight alongside you for 18 seconds

13.name: Frightful Screech
13.description: Release a frightful screech at your target, causing them to flee for 6 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

14.name: Selstie's Aeolian Aria
14.description: Immerse your group in an ethereal aria, granting them the ability to breathe underwater for 18 seconds.

15.name: Whistling Slash II
15.description: Whistle an invigorating tune as you slash at your target, dealing 105% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing your Haste by 20% as well as your Strength and Armor Class by 5 for 30 seconds. This ability requires a one-handed weapon.

effects.stat: as well as your Strength and Armor Class
effects.display: +5 as well as your Strength and Armor Class

15.valuesSummary: 105% weapon dmg · +20% · +5 as well as your Strength and Armor Class

16.name: Mesmerizing Whisper
16.description: Utter a mesmerizing whisper at your target, incapacitating them for 2 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

16.name: Chant of Magic Resistance
16.description: Immerse your party in a rhythmic chant, increasing their Magic Resistance by 5 (L16) to 10 (L36) for 18 seconds.

16.name: Vellicosa's Tantara
16.description: Overwhelm your target with unnerving riffs, dealing 12 (L16) to 100 (L60) Magic Damage every 6 seconds for 18 seconds. This ability stacks with Vellicosa's Fanfare, and will deal an additional 2 (L16) to 20 (L60) damage when afflicted by both.

16.name: Hymn of Inspiration
16.description: Immerse your group in a soothing hymn, increasing their Mana Regeneration by 1 (L8) to 10 (L60) for 18 seconds.

18.name: Aristam's Steady Tread
18.description: Immerse your party with a subdued march, increasing their Movement Speed by 5% (L5) to 10% (L60) for 18 seconds. This ability can be used indoors.

18.name: Disenchanting Blare
18.description: Dispel magic from your target, removing one harmful effect at random.

20.name: Sneak
20.description: Walk silently, rendering you undetectable to targets while behind them.

20.name: Cacophonic Vocalization
20.description: Release a cacophonic shout at your target, dealing 22 Magic Damage, plus 150% (L1) to 350% (L60) damage variance. Costs Mana. Shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

20.name: Sonnet of the Unseen
20.description: Immerse your group in a wistful sonnet, rendering them unseen by the living and granting them the ability to see invisible entities for 18 seconds. This ability has a slight chance to end early, and requires a Wind Instrument.

22.name: Discordant Purge
22.description: Purge magic from your target, removing one beneficial effect at random.

22.name: Paralyzing Shriek
22.description: Release a paralyzing shriek at up to 4 foes around you, stunning them for 3 seconds. This ability costs Mana. This ability shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

24.name: Siren's Enchantment
24.description: Charm your target with an enchanting melody, forcing them to fight alonside you for 18 seconds.

26.name: Subduing Whisper
26.description: Utter a subduing whisper at your target, incapacitating them for 3 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

26.name: Chant of the Elements
26.description: Immerse your party in a rhythmic chant, increasing their Fire, Cold, and Electric Resistance by 5 (L26) to 10 (L46) for 18 seconds.

28.name: Lento's Aria of Apathy
28.description: Oppress nearby targets with an echoing aria, decreasing their Movement Speed by 30% and Attack Speed by 15% for 18 seconds.

28.name: Chords of Rapidity
28.description: Inspire your group with an energetic allegro, increasing their Attack Speed by 20% (L28) to 25% (L32) for 18 seconds.

30.name: Crescendo
30.description: Raise your song in a mighty crescendo, increasing your bonus with all instruments by 50% for 30 seconds. This ability costs Mana.

30.name: Wailing Vocalization
30.description: Release a wailing shout at your target, dealing 29 Magic Damage, with 150% (L1) to 290% (L60) damage variance. Costs Mana. Shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

30.name: Whistling Slash III
30.description: Whistle an invigorating tune as you slash at your target, dealing 110% Weapon Ratio Damage and increasing your Haste by 30% as well as your Strength and Armor Class by 10 for 30 seconds. This ability requires a one-handed weapon.

effects.stat: as well as your Strength and Armor Class
effects.display: +10 as well as your Strength and Armor Class

30.valuesSummary: 110% weapon dmg · +30% · +10 as well as your Strength and Armor Class

32.description: Overwhelm your target with unnerving riffs, dealing 12 (L32) to 20 (L60) Magic Damage every 6 seconds for 18 seconds.

33.name: Harmony of Visions
33.description: Immerse your target in a dreamlike harmony, granting you the ability to see through their eyes.

36.name: Entrancing Whisper
36.description: Utter a entrancing whisper at your target, incapacitating them for 4 seconds. This ability shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.

36.name: Siren's Compulsion
36.description: Charm your target with compulsive melody, forcing them to fight alongside you for 18 seconds.

44.name: Aria De Grave
44.description: Oppress nearby targets with an echoing aria, decreasing their Movement Speed by 40% and Attack Speed by 20% for 18 seconds.

56.name: Hypnotic Whisper

56.name: Aria de Larghissimo
56.description: Oppress nearby targets with an echoing aria, decreasing their Movement Speed by 50% and Attack Speed by 25% for 18 seconds.

60.name: Thunderous Vocalization
60.description: Release a thunderous shout at your target, dealing 60 Magic Damage, with 150% (L1) to 350% (L60) damage variance. Costs Mana. Shares a cooldown with other Shout abilities.
